intent: Create a vertical 9:16 refined path-traced material study of one small porcelain koi automaton rising from black water; the image should feel like collectible design rather than fantasy poster art.

creative_routing.audience_effect: admire the material construction before reading the quiet motion
creative_routing.design_priority: one object, material separation, water contact

scene.summary: a single porcelain koi automaton curves upward from a shallow plane of black water in a dark seamless studio
scene.setting: minimal black studio water tank with no visible horizon clutter

subjects.description: one articulated koi automaton made from ivory porcelain scales, darkened brass joints and a translucent glass tail fin
appearance: brass spine visible only at articulation gaps
subjects.action: curving upward with its lower body still breaking the water surface
subjects.pose: one elegant S-curve with believable articulated joints
subjects.gaze: small dark glass eyes facing slightly upward
relationships: lower porcelain plates displace water and create one coherent ripple system

composition.camera_distance: close enough to read scale overlaps and joint gaps
composition.lens_rationale: compressed collectible-object geometry with a clean silhouette
composition.framing: koi S-curve rises through the center with quiet black space above and around it
composition.foreground_logic: waterline and reflected porcelain establish contact
composition.negative_space: deep black upper third and side margins

lighting.summary: one tall softbox creates long porcelain gradients; narrow controlled strip reflections define brass and glass separately
lighting.rim: thin source-matched edge only on glass tail
lighting.contrast: high-value separation with readable dark metal

materials.microstructure: nearly smooth with tiny kiln variation only at close range
materials.specular_response: broad softbox reflection following each curved plate
materials.subsurface_behavior: very shallow warm light penetration at thin edges
materials.contact_deformation: rigid plates with tight articulated gaps

materials.description: darkened machined brass with selective worn edges
materials.roughness: varies between oxidized recesses and polished contact edges
materials.specular_response: tight reflection only where geometry faces the strip source

materials.description: smoke-clear cast glass with fine internal ribs
materials.roughness: polished outer face with faint cast texture
materials.transmission: clear gray transmission with subtle distortion
materials.contact_deformation: rigid fin mounted into the final brass joint

render_pipeline.lighting_transport: physically based multi-bounce diffuse, specular and transmission transport
render_pipeline.global_illumination: soft studio bounce retained in porcelain and shadowed brass
render_pipeline.ray_tracing: clean reflection and refraction paths with stable water contact
render_pipeline.shadow_model: soft contact-rich shadows without black seams
render_pipeline.ambient_occlusion: very restrained at articulation gaps only
render_pipeline.material_workflow: physically based porcelain, metal and glass with independent roughness
render_pipeline.subsurface_scattering: shallow warm porcelain edge response only
render_pipeline.transmission_refraction: glass tail and water use distinct indices and readable boundaries
render_pipeline.caustics: small restrained water and glass caustics near contact only
render_pipeline.displacement_normal: micro variation remains below silhouette scale
render_pipeline.texture_scale: collectible-object scale; no oversized procedural noise
render_pipeline.sampling_denoise: clean gradients without fireflies or denoise-smudged joint detail
render_pipeline.performance_fidelity_tradeoff: material separation and silhouette outrank background detail

style.realism: physically plausible collectible object with restrained design stylization

must_preserve: porcelain, brass and glass remain distinct
